headline: Build a resilient Z-Wave network
intro: Connect a Z-Wave adapter and server to Home Assistant to manage devices across your home. Add devices with SmartStart or standard inclusion, keep your network when replacing an adapter, and use backups to protect the network stored on the controller.
highlights: Pair devices with SmartStart QR codes or standard inclusion
Migrate a network to a new adapter while keeping its Home Assistant entities
Back up and restore network data and configure a server connection
